search_surface: Bounded format-specific comparison of the four named C++ XML parser libraries (tinyxml2, pugixml, Xerces-C++, libxml++) on Debian popcon dev-package installs, with Homebrew install-on-request (365d) as a second numeric metric. RapidXML (Debian librapidxml-dev) was added from the same snapshots after a scoped candidate passed verification. Whole frameworks (Qt, Boost, POCO) are not ranked.

debian_dev_package_search.method: Binary-package names in the same hashed by_inst table matched by the case-insensitive pattern (xml|xerces|tinyxml|arabica|studxml|expat|sax|markup) plus targeted C++ XML library names (cxxtools, xalan, xqilla, xsdcxx, gdome2-cpp, gsoap, boost, qt6-base, poco); every C++ XML -dev or framework package seen is listed with its decision. Limit: the first 100 'xml' name hits by installations (shared with the C cell's binary search) and the targeted names; not every C++ library is covered.

debian_dev_package_search.round_4_extension: 2026-11-18: the same hashed by_inst snapshot (299486c4) was searched again for C++ -dev packages with an XML parser that the first lookup did not list: binary names containing 'xml' beyond the first 100 hits, plus targeted names (gsoap, opensp/libosp, libcutl, ace/acexml, arabica, xmlwrapp, ticpp, libstudxml). Rows added: libosp-dev, libcutl-dev, libace-xml-utils-dev, libacexml-dev. xmlwrapp, ticpp and libstudxml have no binary package in the snapshot.

round_4_description_search.method: Every Debian sid binary package ending in -dev whose name or description contains 'xml' (case-insensitive), joined with the pinned by_inst installations; 131 packages have at least one installation. Packages for other languages (Haskell, OCaml, Rust, Go, Ada, Fortran, Tcl, PHP), C libraries (expat, libxml2, libxmlsec1, mxml, libxmlb, libnxml0, libplist, libtidy, xmlrpc-c, wbxml2, liblouisxml, libcomps) and GObject introspection data are outside this cell; the C++ rows are listed with their decisions.
